description.zh:
管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The description of the control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
管控策略的生效范围。

取值：RAM，表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
description.en:
The effective scope of the control policy.

Valid value: RAM. This indicates that the control policy applies only to RAM users or RAM roles.

description.zh:
管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见[管控策略语言](~~179096~~)。

管控策略示例，请参见[自定义管控策略示例](~~181474~~)。
description.en:
The policy document.

The policy document can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the policy language, see [Control Policy Language](~~179096~~).

For examples, see [Examples of Custom Control Policies](~~181474~~).

description.zh:
管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
The tags to attach to the control policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster create-control-policy --policy-name ExampleControlPolicy --description ExampleControlPolicy --effect-scope RAM --policy-document Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --control-policy-type RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster CreateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --Description ExampleControlPolicy --PolicyName ExampleControlPolicy --Tag.1.Value v1 --PolicyDocument 'Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole' --ControlPolicyType RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --EffectScope RAM --method POST --force
